# Temporary vendor-procedure fixture

> This is not a signed vendor contract, a dispatch procedure, an access policy,
> or authority to disclose resident information. It is a synthetic fixture used
> to test lower-precedence vendor-contract retrieval and citation behavior.

## Accountable owner

The Vendor Management Owner must replace this document with the applicable
executed agreement and approved operational annexes. Until then, no vendor
obligation, response time, availability, rate, access right, or data-sharing
permission may be inferred from this file.

## Safe workflow boundary

For a potential vendor action, an authorized human must first confirm the
approved work order, scope, property authorization, and minimum necessary
contact/access information. The product may prepare an evidence-backed
proposal only. It cannot schedule, transmit a work order, reveal a credential,
or grant property access.

## Privacy and access constraints

- Do not collect or display government IDs, keys, alarm codes, or unnecessary
  resident/household details in knowledge content or retrieval output.
- Do not make eligibility or scheduling decisions from protected, health, or
  family information.
- If the actual vendor terms are missing, expired, or conflict with a higher
  authority, abstain and escalate to Vendor Management.

## Production replacement checklist

An eligible replacement must identify the executed agreement/version, parties,
effective dates, authorized service scope, privacy terms, escalation contact,
and document owner. The steward must retain cited source spans and make the
agreement available only to authorized users.
